trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Strait Threats
trends.summary: Iran rejects US ceasefire proposals and sets five conditions for negotiations, threatening to activate Bab El-Mandeb Strait and close Hormuz if attacked. Netanyahu announces expanded military operations in Lebanon and against Iran. This geopolitical escalation directly threatens global oil supply and shipping routes, with Iran collecting $10B monthly from oil revenues used for terror financing.

trends.name: Trump Impeachment Odds Surge to 73%
trends.summary: Prediction market data shows Trump impeachment probability has climbed to 73%, trending steadily higher in recent months. This reflects rising political uncertainty and potential policy reversals that could impact markets, trade policies, and regulatory environment.

trends.name: Meta Layoffs & AI Pivot Accelerates
trends.summary: Meta laying off hundreds of workers across Reality Labs, Facebook and other departments as AI transformation accelerates. Simultaneously, Meta faces legal liability from LA jury finding the company negligent in social media addiction case, creating dual pressures on profitability and regulatory costs.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Filing Reports & Space Stock Rally
trends.summary: Reports of SpaceX's imminent IPO filing are driving broad space stock rallies. This represents a major liquidity event and validates the commercialization of aerospace, with potential ripple effects across satellite, defense contracting, and aerospace manufacturing sectors.

trends.name: Trump Tech Leadership Council Appointment
trends.summary: Trump administration appointing Mark Zuckerberg, Larry Ellison, and Jensen Huang to the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. This signals tech industry influence over AI policy and federal tech regulation, with major implications for innovation, competition, and sector favorability.

trends.name: Meta Social Media Addiction Liability Verdict
trends.summary: LA jury finds Meta negligent in social media addiction trial, with New Mexico AG calling it a landmark decision sending message to entire industry. Opens door for significant damages and regulatory tightening around child safety protections, affecting Meta's future compliance costs and litigation risk.

trends.name: Oil Market Volatility & Geopolitical Pricing
trends.summary: Oil traders pricing in Middle East ceasefire prospects while weighing Iran war impacts on production. Geopolitical risk premium volatile as Strait of Hormuz access threatened; damage to regional oil/gas infrastructure could spike prices and shift energy markets significantly.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates Near 6-Month High
trends.summary: Mortgage rates climbing to 6-month highs despite Freddie/Fannie bond buying support. Rising rates pressure housing affordability, consumer balance sheets, and refinancing activity—key indicators of Fed policy trajectory and economic slowdown risk ahead.

trends.name: Trump Administration Regulatory Rollbacks
trends.summary: Trump administration waiving gasoline regulations to address surging fuel prices and deploying National Guard to airports. Signals broader deregulation agenda and supply-chain intervention approach, benefiting energy sector but creating execution/political risk.

trends.name: Trump-Xi Summit in May Signals US-China Thaw
trends.summary: White House announces Trump will meet Xi in China in May, signaling potential diplomatic reset in US-China relations. Could impact tariff expectations, semiconductor trade, and emerging markets—major driver of risk sentiment and trade-exposed stocks.

trends.name: Sports Betting Impact on Consumer Credit Health
trends.summary: NY Federal Reserve highlights sports betting surge during March Madness as toll on consumer credit health. Emerging trend of rising defaults and debt stress tied to gambling, signaling potential consumer financial weakness and credit cycle turning point.

trends.name: Palantir as Trump 'Golden Dome' Government Tech Winner
trends.summary: Palantir positioned as major beneficiary of Trump's $185 billion 'Golden Dome' government tech initiative. Defense/intelligence spending boost creates multi-year revenue visibility for government software contractors and surveillance tech providers.
